page.notes: The scan is blurred and the Hebrew and Chaldean words are hard to read. Those marked [?] are best readings. The Hebrew at the end of the second Chaldean line, the Hebrew after "Hebraicis literis", and the word after "Hebr." are doubtful. The catchword at the foot is partly lost. The last printed token, after "Act. 2. 34.", is unclear and was read as the catchword "Re[?]". Original spelling kept, with long s written as s. Printed "Hosea" is printed as "Hofeo" and is given here as printed. The page has no greek text.
